title: autospec-fleet desired state
description: Schema for autospec-fleet.yml, the shared fleet desired-state file. It declares managed repositories, workspace placement, profile defaults, and optional config-repo sync metadata.

workspace.description: Directory where autospec-fleet stores managed repository checkouts.

default_profile.description: Profile used by repos that do not set an explicit profile.

parallel_repos.description: Maximum number of repositories this desired state permits a node to run concurrently.

config_repo.description: Git repository URL containing the canonical fleet config.

ref.description: Branch, tag, or ref to fetch from the config repository.

repos.description: Target repositories managed by this fleet.

url.description: HTTPS or SSH GitHub repository URL.

profile.description: Model profile override for this repository.

enabled.description: When false, fleet status may report the repo but run scheduling skips it.
